readme_excerpt: Best-of Python 🏆  A ranked list of awesome Python open-source libraries & tools. Updated weekly. This curated list contains 400 awesome open-source projects with a total of 2.1M stars grouped into 28 categories. All projects are ranked by a project-quality score, which is calculated based on various metrics automatically collected from GitHub and different package managers.
